case_goal: Verify that an existing user can successfully log in to Admidio.
summary: Navigate to the overview page, enter valid credentials (admin/admin), click Sign in, and confirm authentication by the presence of user-specific links and user name.

steps.expected_result: Login page appears with fields for username, password, organization, and a Sign in button.
Login name field is cleared and text 'admin' is entered.
Password field is cleared and text 'admin' is entered.
Form submitted; page redirects or reloads showing authenticated state.
Page displays 'My profile' link, 'Sign out' link, and user name 'Paul Schmidt' (or 'admin') indicating successful login.
